name: Yandere Game
source:
—A tragedy befalls a girl who has just been dumped by her boyfriend—

This browser game, originally released on April Fools’ Day 2012, has been ported to Kirikiri and made available for download.
Please keep in mind that it was created as an “April Fools’ Day game” when playing.
